messages:
Asha Patel: quick heads-up — int4 bring-up for q4b on staging shows ~3% drop vs float on PromptSet-Summarize (longform). doing a root-cause pass; need Labeling Ops to expand golden coverage and run targeted relabels
Riley Chen: ouch. where is the delta concentrated? hallucinations, truncation, or style drift?
Asha Patel: mostly missing detail and some inference errors on bullet-list extraction. consistent across ~1.2k samples but not catastrophic
Marta Gomez: avoid wholesale relabels. propose focused waves: 500 high-entropy prompts + 300 edge paraphrases. can we get an export with model-conf and token-length filters?
Jin Park: yea, I'll export top-entropy where tokens>512 and include existing golden matches for de-dupe
Asha Patel: add label instructions tweak: "preserve numeric detail where present" and mark allowed variance examples
labeler-bot: export job queued: job_id=job_2026_173659; output: s3://redwood-lab/exports/job_2026_173659.csv — ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Riley Chen: de-dupe strategy? fuzzy-hash + token overlap?
Marta Gomez: using fuzzyhash_v2 threshold=0.85 + token_jaccard>=0.6; keep up to 3 paraphrases per canonical. will tag priority for top entropy quartile
Kai: lock eval harness? we want apples-to-apples comparisons before prompt normalization tweaks
Asha Patel: lock harness. normalization after we confirm degradation persists post-golden update
Jin Park: reproducible export snippet:
```
python tools/export_high_entropy.py --model q4b-int4-staging --metric entropy --top 500 \
  --min_tokens 512 --include_golden_matches true --out job_2026_173659.csv
```
Marta Gomez: de-dupe -> split into 50/sample batches. labeler lead @Riley PTAL on SLA
Riley Chen: ETA for labeling wave 1 (800 samples): 48h after queueing. I'll assign 4 labelers + 2 floaters
Asha Patel: also create a micro-golden of 100 synthetic variants (paraphrases, truncations) to catch regressions fast
labeler-bot: micro-golden mg_173659_01 created and will be injected post-batch completion
Jin Park: after labels land, run eval harness and diff token-level metrics. I'll add dashboard tile: q4b_int4_vs_float_promptset_summarize (include BLEU/ROUGE-L + recall@fact + token-latency)
Marta Gomez: operational: ensure labelers have guideline doc v2.1 in queue — changes: keep numeric units exact, prefer explicit source mention if generated
Asha Patel: next steps: Jin export -> Marta de-dupe & queue -> Riley run SLA -> labelers + micro-golden -> Jin eval diff. flag me for canary rollback in Dedicated if needed
Riley Chen: noted. ping when batches live, I'll monitor throughput and QA yields
Jin Park: export complete, uploaded s3://redwood-lab/exports/job_2026_173659.csv md5:d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
Marta Gomez: de-dupe done. final count 832 (500 high-entropy + 332 edge paraphs). pushed 17 batches to labeler-queue
labeler-bot: 17 batches enqueued: queue_id=q_173659_a; estimated completion 48h
Asha Patel: great — after labels land let's review top 40 failures and decide if this is quant artifact or data gap. thanks! :raised_hands:
